output.reason: The changelog line [ev-28622e136e8f] doesn't settle applicability by itself, but the upgrade-guide section does. [ev-c6e07f70e7d9] names the setting in both forms, the YAML key `max_transfer_retries` and the CLI flag `-ingester.max-transfer-retries`, and says it was removed in favor of the WAL. It also explains the setting moved chunks to new ingesters during rolling restarts, so the exposed environments are those that set the key or the flag. [ev-b19cd3bb8e8b] and [ev-8ec3d6c379c3] give the replacements: enable WAL replay, optionally with `flush_on_shutdown`, or flush manually through the `/shutdown?flush=true` endpoint.
